title: Daily quote banner: remove timezone prompt and auto-refresh at 08:00 UK time

requirements.summary: Remove the daily quote banner's dependency on a user-saved time zone and always fetch/display the daily quote for authenticated users.
acceptanceCriteria: The quote banner (DailyMotivationalQuote) no longer shows the "Set your time zone to see your daily motivational quote" prompt as a prerequisite for displaying the quote.
The quote banner successfully displays a quote for an authenticated user even if they have never saved a time zone.
If the quote cannot be loaded, the existing "Quote unavailable" fallback remains shown in English.

file_operations.description: Remove the user-time-zone query gating from the quote fetch so getTodaysQuote() is fetched for authenticated users regardless of saved time zone; simplify state so needsTimeZone is no longer required, while preserving the existing error handling and refetch capability.

Stop rendering the TimeZoneInlinePrompt flow; always render loading, quote, or the existing English "Quote unavailable" fallback based on the updated useDailyZenQuote state, without changing the banner location or overall layout.

requirements.summary: Automatically refetch and update the displayed quote shortly after the next 08:00 UK time rollover while the app remains open, without frequent polling.
acceptanceCriteria: If a user has the app open across the 08:00 UK time boundary, the displayed quote updates to the new daily quote shortly after 08:00 UK time without manual refresh.
No excessive polling is introduced (the app should schedule a refetch around the next 08:00 UK time rollover rather than frequently refetching).

file_operations.description: Add a small utility for computing the milliseconds until the next 08:00 in Europe/London using built-in Intl APIs (no third-party libraries), suitable for scheduling a single refetch timer.

Add a one-shot scheduling mechanism (setTimeout) that, when authenticated and a quote has been fetched (or attempted), schedules a refetch shortly after the next Europe/London 08:00 rollover; ensure timers are cleared/recomputed on identity/actor changes and that this does not introduce frequent polling.
